svg.desc: Log-log plot of the relative error in recovered permeability-thickness against the standard deviation of the added pressure noise. Two curves: the mean over 200 seeds, and the 95th percentile of the same 200. Both rise close to linearly with sigma, from about 3.64e-4 at 0.1 psi to about 3.68e-2 at 10 psi for the mean, with the 95th percentile between two and three times the mean throughout. The table gives every value together with the Monte Carlo standard error of each mean.
